name: The Sage
description: Analytical, truth-seeking, highly technical; relies on logic.
risk: Can come across as cold, robotic, or dismissive to emotional customers.

name: The Caregiver
risk: May over-apologize, lose authority, or burn out facing demanding customers.

name: The Everyman
strengths: Rapid rapport with expressive and cooperative customers.
risk: May lack the formal authority demanding or analytical customers expect.

name: The Fixer
description: Assertive, efficient, focused on swift resolution.
strengths: Highly effective with analytical and hesitant customers.
risk: Can rush distressed customers, leaving them feeling unheard.

name: The Innovator
description: Imaginative and original; looks for out-of-the-box workarounds.
risk: May frustrate customers who want strict adherence to documented policy.

name: The Diplomat
description: Balanced, tactful, skilled at emotional alignment.
strengths: Adapts to nearly any customer profile.
risk: High burnout risk from constant deep acting; can let calls drift.
